event.headline: Demonstration: the fictional Central Bank of Demoland lowers its policy rate by 50 basis points

summary: FICTIONAL demonstration hypothesis: an easier policy stance by the fictional Central Bank of Demoland may lower the fictional demonstration rate and weaken the fictional currency index. Written after the invented data, for the offline demo only; the event, the institution and every number are invented.
